title: Growth Product Manager Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen product growth expertise, build a senior-level portfolio, and prepare for leadership interviews. Focuses on metrics, experimentation, SQL, copy, prioritisation, and analytics tools.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core growth concepts and data foundations.

milestones.title: Growth funnel fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can map end-to-end user funnels and identify key drop-off points.

tasks.title: Read funnel basics article
tasks.description: Study the funnel section in the Growth Handbook (free PDF) to understand stages and metrics.

tasks.title: Sketch a funnel for a known app
tasks.description: Create a hand-drawn funnel diagram for a popular app, labeling each stage and metric.

tasks.title: Watch funnel metrics video
tasks.description: Watch the freeCodeCamp YouTube video on funnel analysis and take notes.

tasks.title: Reflect on funnel gaps
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph on where the chosen app loses users and why.

milestones.title: SQL refresher for Product data
milestones.outcome: Can write queries to extract funnel and cohort data from a relational database.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics module
tasks.description: Finish the freeCodeCamp SQL certification lessons covering SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY.

tasks.title: Query sample dataset
tasks.description: Use the public Kaggle “eCommerce” dataset to pull daily sign-up counts per source.

tasks.title: Build a cohort query
tasks.description: Write a SQL query that returns 7-day retention cohorts for new users.

tasks.title: Explain query results
tasks.description: Summarize findings in a one-page report highlighting retention trends.

phases.title: Core Growth skills
phases.summary: Develop advanced experimentation, copy, and prioritisation capabilities.

milestones.title: Design experiments
milestones.outcome: Can create testable hypotheses, define metrics, and size experiments.

tasks.title: Read experiment design guide
tasks.description: Study the Optimizely free guide on hypothesis framing and sample size calculation.

tasks.title: Draft three experiment proposals
tasks.description: Write concise experiment briefs for a signup flow, onboarding email, and pricing page.

tasks.title: Calculate sample sizes
tasks.description: Use an online calculator to determine required traffic for each proposal.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a peer
tasks.description: Share the briefs with a colleague and incorporate their suggestions.

milestones.title: Copy and onboarding optimization
milestones.outcome: Can craft persuasive copy and redesign onboarding steps to boost activation.

tasks.title: Study onboarding case studies
tasks.description: Read the Mixpanel blog post on onboarding best practices and note key tactics.

tasks.title: Rewrite signup copy
tasks.description: Create three headline variations for a signup page, focusing on value and clarity.

tasks.title: Map current onboarding flow
tasks.description: Diagram the existing onboarding steps of a SaaS product using Lucidchart (free tier).

tasks.title: Propose flow improvements
tasks.description: Suggest two changes to reduce friction, backed by copy principles.

tasks.title: Share revisions on a forum
tasks.description: Post the revised copy on the GrowthHackers community for critique.

phases.title: Portfolio projects
phases.summary: Create tangible work samples that demonstrate senior-level growth impact.

milestones.title: Public funnel analysis project
milestones.outcome: Portfolio includes a detailed funnel analysis with actionable insights.

tasks.title: Select a public product
tasks.description: Choose a well-known app (e.g., Spotify) and gather publicly available usage data.

tasks.title: Analyze funnel stages
tasks.description: Use Excel or Google Sheets to calculate conversion rates between stages.

tasks.title: Write analysis report
tasks.description: Draft a 2-page report with charts, findings, and three recommendations.

tasks.title: Create visual deck
tasks.description: Design a slide deck (Google Slides) summarizing the analysis for stakeholders.

tasks.title: Publish on portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload the report and deck to your personal website or Notion portfolio.

milestones.title: Experiment backlog & sizing
milestones.outcome: Shows ability to prioritize and size a growth experiment pipeline.

tasks.title: Gather past experiment ideas
tasks.description: Collect at least 10 experiment concepts from previous work or brainstorming sessions.

tasks.title: Score each idea
tasks.description: Apply the RICE framework to assign a priority score to each experiment.

tasks.title: Estimate effort and impact
tasks.description: Create a spreadsheet estimating development time and expected lift for each experiment.

tasks.title: Visualize backlog roadmap
tasks.description: Use a free roadmap tool (e.g., Trello) to map experiments over a quarter.

tasks.title: Get mentor review
tasks.description: Share the backlog with a senior PM for feedback on feasibility and prioritisation.

phases.title: Getting ready for senior roles
phases.summary: Polish leadership presence, advanced analytics, and interview readiness.

milestones.title: Use advanced analytics tools
milestones.outcome: Can extract insights using Amplitude or Mixpanel and present dashboards.

tasks.title: Complete Amplitude free tutorial
tasks.description: Follow Amplitude’s official tutorial to set up events and create a funnel report.

tasks.title: Build a retention dashboard
tasks.description: Design a Mixpanel dashboard showing weekly active users and churn trends.

tasks.title: Interpret dashboard metrics
tasks.description: Write a brief analysis of what the dashboard reveals about product health.

tasks.title: Share dashboard with peers
tasks.description: Present the dashboard in a Slack channel and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Leadership & Interview prep
milestones.outcome: Ready to articulate growth strategy and lead cross-functional teams in senior interviews.

tasks.title: Read senior PM interview guide
tasks.description: Study the “Product Management Interview” chapter on growth strategy from the free guide by Exponent.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR-formatted stories highlighting funnel improvements, experiments, and prioritisation decisions.

tasks.title: Mock interview with peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 45-minute mock interview focusing on growth questions and receive feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback
tasks.description: Summarize key takeaways and action items from the mock interview.

tasks.title: Update portfolio with leadership lens
tasks.description: Add a section to each project describing team impact and decision-making role.
